title: Neuron-JS benchmark result contract
description: Stable machine-readable result format for NJS-GROWTH-07 benchmark and visual-proof assets. Placeholder fixtures are explicitly non-claim data.

engine.source: Harness adapter name for the implementation under test; fixed enum for cross-run joins.
engine.description: Harness adapter name for the implementation under test; fixed enum for cross-run joins.

scenario.source: Scenario slug produced by the benchmark scenario matrix.
scenario.description: Scenario slug produced by the benchmark scenario matrix.

input_size.source: Named workload profile, not raw row count, so visual assets can group runs consistently.
input_size.description: Named workload profile, not raw row count, so visual assets can group runs consistently.

warmup_iterations.source: Number of unmeasured warmup decisions completed before timing.
warmup_iterations.description: Number of unmeasured warmup decisions completed before timing.

measured_iterations.source: Number of measured decisions included in timing statistics.
measured_iterations.description: Number of measured decisions included in timing statistics.

throughput_decisions_per_second.source: Measured decisions divided by elapsed measured wall-clock seconds.
throughput_decisions_per_second.description: Measured decisions divided by elapsed measured wall-clock seconds.

p50_ms.source: Median per-decision latency from measured iterations.
p50_ms.description: Median per-decision latency from measured iterations.

p95_ms.source: 95th percentile per-decision latency from measured iterations.
p95_ms.description: 95th percentile per-decision latency from measured iterations.

cold_start_ms.source: Wall-clock time to load/import the engine adapter and execute the first decision in a fresh process or isolated worker.
cold_start_ms.description: Wall-clock time to load/import the engine adapter and execute the first decision in a fresh process or isolated worker.

bundle_size_minified_bytes.source: Minified adapter+engine bundle byte count from the configured bundler output.
bundle_size_minified_bytes.description: Minified adapter+engine bundle byte count from the configured bundler output.

validation_overhead_ms.source: Additional median latency for validation-enabled execution versus validation-disabled execution on the same scenario/input profile.
validation_overhead_ms.description: Additional median latency for validation-enabled execution versus validation-disabled execution on the same scenario/input profile.

explanation_overhead_ms.source: Additional median latency for trace/explanation-enabled execution versus trace-disabled execution on the same scenario/input profile.
explanation_overhead_ms.description: Additional median latency for trace/explanation-enabled execution versus trace-disabled execution on the same scenario/input profile.

node_version.source: Node.js version reported by process.version for the benchmark run.
node_version.description: Node.js version reported by process.version for the benchmark run.

package_version.source: Package version or source label for the engine adapter under test.
package_version.description: Package version or source label for the engine adapter under test.

commit_sha.source: Repository commit SHA for the Neuron-JS benchmark harness and local implementation.
commit_sha.description: Repository commit SHA for the Neuron-JS benchmark harness and local implementation.

result_kind.description: Distinguishes measured results from non-claim sample fixtures.

notes.description: Required caveats, methodology notes, or placeholder warnings.
